Player 1 — choose your hero avatar

Original avatar options inspired by broad favorites for ages 9–10: block-building games, creature adventures, manga-style action, and speedy competition.

Design basis: broad elementary-age interests repeatedly surfaced in current kid media references, including Minecraft and Roblox-style building/play communities from Common Sense Media, plus Scholastic's continuing Grades 2–5 popularity around humorous graphic novels and manga-flavored reading like Captain Underpants / Dog Man.

Player 2 — choose your hero avatar

Player 2 can choose independently. The same avatar may be chosen by both players.

Reference basis: English 4th-grade Unit 1 campus assessment, 71 students, overall 62.4%. Item-level comparison performance included 43.7% on Item 2 and 49.3% fully correct on Items 6 and 8; equivalence Items 1 and 7 were 50.7%. No English-vs.-Spanish numerical comparison is built into this game because the supplied reference did not include a Spanish assessment export.
